recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.(debug|release)/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
wget -q -O /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -- https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.14.0/node-v22.14.0-linux-x64.tar.xz
sha256sum -c <<< '69b09dba5c8dcb05c4e4273a4340db1005abeafe3927efda2bc5b249e80437ec  /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip'
tar xf /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-v22.14.0-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
export UNSIGNED_APK=1
export NODE_OPTIONS="--openssl-legacy-provider --max_old_space_size=4096"
npm config set prefix "${HOME}/.node"
npm install
npm ci && npm rebuild lightningcss
bash ./scripts/android_build.sh prod-foss
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-align --pad-like-apksigner --replace android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
